scenarios.name: The First Night
scenarios.briefing: A handful of families and four militia, a Keep, and fifteen days before the dark closes in. They will come from the west, where the plain is open: build homes, gather wood and stone, and have a wall across the west before the first of them. Nothing from the Scriptorium yet, and only the simplest towers.

triggers.say: Dusk on the new colony. Fifteen days until the dark closes in.
triggers.speaker: steward

triggers.say: Scouts report movement on the western plain. The first wave lands at the end of tomorrow: is the west wall finished?
triggers.speaker: scout

triggers.say: A caravan from the south: timber and stone for the walls.
triggers.speaker: steward

scenarios.name: Iron in the Hills
scenarios.briefing: The highlands have stone and iron to spare, and room for little else. Grow the colony to forty souls, arm them, and hold for twenty days.

triggers.say: The town has grown large enough to be noticed. Hounds are coming from the east.
triggers.speaker: scout

scenarios.name: The Gatekeepers
scenarios.briefing: Two Hellgates have torn open in the plains, and they feed every wave. Go out and close them. The walls only have to hold until you do.

triggers.say: The gates feed every wave. Each one you close makes the waves smaller, and closing both wins the day.
triggers.speaker: captain

triggers.say: Six days until the Convergence. The gates must fall before it does.
triggers.speaker: captain

scenarios.name: Drowned Country
scenarios.briefing: Lakes everywhere and little dry ground. The water will hold the horde for you where the land narrows: find the chokepoints and wall them.

triggers.say: Winged things are crossing the water from the south.
triggers.speaker: scout

scenarios.name: The Causeway
scenarios.briefing: A town on a causeway across a river, cliffs east and west. They will come down both banks from the north and the south, through gaps in the ridges. Wall the near gaps and you're safe, and cramped: sixty people won't fit. The good ground lies out between the near gaps and the far ones.

triggers.say: Four gaps in the ridges near us, two on each bank, and four more further out. Wall the near ones first.
triggers.speaker: captain

triggers.say: Masons from downriver, with stone enough to wall the far gaps. Everything between is ours if we take it.
triggers.speaker: steward

scenarios.name: The Pass
scenarios.briefing: A narrow way through the ridges, and everything the mountains hold coming down it. Forty days, and four thousand of them to put down.

triggers.say: Miners from the next valley join you, with what they could carry.
triggers.speaker: steward

triggers.say: Scouts report green things among the horde that spit bile over the walls. Keep the towers back from the parapet.
triggers.speaker: scout

scenarios.name: Two Fronts
scenarios.briefing: The waves will come from the east and the west, and only there. North, behind the old wall, is the richest country in the march: iron, stone, silver, and an old reliquary whose relic we need. It is also thick with demons, asleep. Clear a way in, a piece at a time, when you can spare the soldiers.

triggers.say: The north is waking to the noise of the town. Go in when you choose, not when they do.
triggers.speaker: scout

triggers.say: The relic is home. Now hold both fronts to the end.
triggers.speaker: abbess

scenarios.name: Wildwood Watch
scenarios.briefing: Deep forest: wood for a hundred walls, and no clear ground to see them coming. The trees are your wall, until your own woodsmen cut them down: every tree they fell is a way in. Fell the ones you want the horde to use, and build your killing ground there. Forty-five days.

triggers.say: Every tree the woodsmen fell is a new way in. Choose where the woods open, before the horde chooses for you.
triggers.speaker: scout

triggers.say: Howling in the trees to the west.
triggers.speaker: scout

triggers.say: The old texts speak of silver veins at the edge of the world. Exorcists are made of it, if the holy ground can reach that far.
triggers.speaker: abbess

scenarios.name: The Reliquary
scenarios.briefing: Beyond the lakes lie the old reliquary towns, taken in the first years of the war. Their people stand guard over them still, as Thralls. Clear three of them and bring back what the faithful left behind, then hold until the Convergence.

triggers.say: Six old towns within a few days' march. The dead stand watch in every one. Send soldiers, not colonists.
triggers.speaker: abbess

triggers.say: The dead at the ruins don't sleep deeply. Towers first, then go.
triggers.speaker: captain

triggers.say: Three reliquaries emptied. Now bring everyone home and hold.
triggers.speaker: steward

scenarios.name: The Long Siege
scenarios.briefing: The full sixty days, and the Convergence at the end of them. Everything you have learned.

triggers.say: Refugees from the fallen towns to the south, with what they could carry. Something followed them.
triggers.speaker: steward

triggers.say: The horde that hunted the refugees is at the southern edge.
triggers.speaker: scout

triggers.say: Five days to the Convergence. Everything you have.
triggers.speaker: captain

scenarios.name: The Bridge
scenarios.briefing: One bridge over the river to the east, and everything in the east will come across it. Every wave, and at the end the Convergence, all of it over that bridge. Build for that day.

triggers.say: Ten days. Whatever you mean to have at the bridge, build it now.
triggers.speaker: captain

scenarios.name: The Hellwall
scenarios.briefing: The last line. Four Hellgates, a harder horde, sixty days. Close every gate, and survive what comes through before you do.

triggers.say: The last gate falls. Now hold the wall.
triggers.speaker: captain
